segments.ja475:1.3: Puṭṭho me samma akkhāhi, kiṃ dāruṃ chetumicchasi.
segments.ja475:2.1: Isso [iso (sī.), īso (syā. pī.)] vanāni carasi, samāni visamāni ca;
segments.ja475:2.3: Puṭṭho me samma akkhāhi, kiṃ dāruṃ nemiyā daḷhaṃ.
segments.ja475:3.1: Neva sālo na khadiro, nāssakaṇṇo kuto dhavo;
segments.ja475:3.3: Rukkho ca [rukkhova (sī. pī.)] phandano nāma, taṃ dāruṃ nemiyā daḷhaṃ.
segments.ja475:4.1: Kīdisānissa pattāni, khandho vā pana kīdiso;
segments.ja475:4.3: Puṭṭho me samma akkhāhi, yathā jānemu phandanaṃ.
segments.ja475:5.1: Yassa sākhā palambanti, namanti na ca bhañjare;
segments.ja475:5.3: So rukkho phandano nāma, yassa mūle ahaṃ ṭhito.
segments.ja475:6.3: Sabbassa te kammaniyo, ayaṃ hessati phandano.
segments.ja475:7.3: Mayhampi vacanaṃ atthi, bhāradvāja suṇohi me.
segments.ja475:8.1: Issassa [imassa (ka. sī. ka.)] upakkhandhamhā [upakhandhamhā (ka. sī. pī. ka.)], ukkacca caturaṅgulaṃ;
segments.ja475:8.3: Tena nemiṃ pasāresi [pariharesi (sī. pī.)], evaṃ daḷhataraṃ siyā.
segments.ja475:10.1: Iccevaṃ [icceva (sī. pī.)] phandano issaṃ, isso ca pana phandanaṃ;
segments.ja475:12.1: Taṃ vo vadāmi bhaddaṃ vo [bhaddante (ka.)], yāvantettha samāgatā;
segments.ja475:12.3: Sammodatha mā vivadatha [māvivadittha (sī. syā. pī.)], mā hotha issaphandanā.
